description: This file defines utility methods for handling API version strings, including parsing JSON-formatted inputs into ApiVersion objects, serializing collections of ApiVersion objects into JSON strings, sanitizing raw inputs, and determining the preferred API version supported by the server.

classes.name: ApiVersionUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for parsing, serializing, sanitizing, and selecting API versions.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw JSON string into a collection of ApiVersion objects, handling various JSON formats and ignoring invalid entries.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a collection of ApiVersion objects into a JSON string; returns null if input is null or empty.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes a raw string by parsing it into ApiVersion objects and then serializing back into a standardized string format.

methods.name: getPreferredApiVersion
methods.description: Determines the highest supported ApiVersion from a raw JSON string, filtered by the application's supported major versions.
